terms.story_spine: The narrative thesis created by the Master Orchestrator that explains what the system is really telling and why it matters.
terms.lens: One of the six permanent brand perspectives used to interpret a place.
terms.research_dossier: The structured output of a research agent, containing factual findings, source references, notes, and usable editorial signals.
terms.product_brief: The execution-ready output of the Product Adapter for one concrete SKU or product format.
terms.theme_cluster: A coherent editorial territory inside a country, derived from one primary lens and optionally supported by secondary lenses.
terms.collection: A named customer-facing line of products that belongs to one primary theme cluster.
terms.hero_subjects: The primary visual subjects of a collection or cluster, e.g. Sicilian coastal roads, fishing boats, baroque facades.
terms.hero_elements: The objects or details inside a subject, e.g. nets, anchors, prow shapes, market crates, arch details.
terms.hero_subject_matrix: The role assignment of subjects using the allowed roles hero, supporting, background_system.
terms.visual_grammar: The immutable visual rules of the brand or collection, e.g. line art, black and white, no fills, editorial hierarchy.
terms.visual_logic: How subjects and elements are composed inside a product, e.g. one hero landscape per cover, alternating dense and open pages.
terms.visual_direction: The style notes used by the Product Adapter to build generation prompts, e.g. nostalgic illustration, warm editorial tone, high detail.
terms.map_blueprint: The high-level editorial strategy for a narrative or informational map, including product goal, narrative goal, primary focus areas, and content constraints. Equivalent to collection_blueprint but map-specific.
terms.map_structure: The organizational logic of a map, including geographic areas, POI grouping, route layers, legend structure, and label density strategy.
terms.style_profile: The visual design system for a map, including style family, color palette, line treatment, icon direction, and background treatment. Map-specific equivalent to visual_direction.
terms.map_product_package: The execution-ready output for a map product, including title, subtitle, deliverables (PDF variants, SVG master), listing logic, and derived product suggestions. Map-specific equivalent to product_brief.
terms.poi_groups: Points of Interest organized by category or narrative function in a map, e.g. Tea Culture, Sacred Sites, Craft Locations.
terms.route_layers: Visual and navigational routes or journeys in a map, e.g. walking paths, trade routes, pilgrimage circuits, represented with specific line styles or patterns.
terms.label_density: The information density strategy for a map, measured on scale (low / medium / high), determining how many labels, POI, and details are visible at once.
terms.legend_plan: The structured key or legend for a map, documenting all symbols, colors, icons, and their meanings, ensuring consistent interpretation across deliverables.

anti_synonym_rule: Agents must use these exact terms and must not introduce alternative synonyms for the same concept.
